title: Host Protect
subtitle: On-box web malware control plane. Not Guard and not SIEM.
featureOff: Host Protect is not enabled in this environment.
emptyHint: Register a document root on a Guard agent. Scans stay on the host; hits are not mixed with IP/domain findings.
name: Name
limitReached: Site limit reached for this SKU.
hitsWaitingAgent: Scan is queued on the Guard host. Hits appear after the on-box helper reads this document root. The SaaS worker does not mount customer disks.
hitsClean: Last scan finished with no matching signatures in the files it could read (cap 500 files, 1 MiB each).
scanQueued: Scan queued — waiting for the Guard host helper.
noAgents: Install a Guard agent first, then register a site here.
scanUnreachableRoot: Document root is not reachable on the scan worker. No mock hits were recorded.
honestyHint: Hits are only from files the worker can read. Missing roots fail; they do not invent malware.
wafHint: Per-site HTTP WAF policy. Events are not malware hits. Engine is mock until Coraza ships.
wafFeatureOff: Host WAF is not enabled in this environment.
wafNeedSite: Add a Host Protect site first, then set WAF mode.
wafCopyOk: Snippet copied. Do not paste onto sinexis.app edge nginx.
